product_overview: QR Captain is a vessel maintenance tracking platform that connects boat owners with marine mechanics through QR-code-enabled digital service records. It facilitates vessel management, equipment tracking, work order processing, and a trusted mechanic marketplace with an integrated rating and messaging system.
core_goals: Provide boat owners with a centralized, digital maintenance history accessible via unique QR codes.
Enable marine mechanics to scan QR codes for instant access to vessel service records and streamline work order management.
Create a trusted ecosystem with reputation systems, secure access control, and direct communication between owners and mechanics.
Offer role-adaptive interfaces and comprehensive notification and help systems to maximize user engagement and support.
Ensure robust performance, security, and reliability using real-time data and cloud backend services.
key_features: Vessel Management: Owners can register vessels, upload photos, and generate unique QR codes linking to maintenance records.
Equipment Manifest: Categorized onboard equipment inventory with service intervals, warranty tracking, condition monitoring, and photo uploads.
QR Code Scanning: Web and mobile QR scanning for mechanics to identify vessels and request access.
Vessel Access Authorization: Mechanic access requests with owner approval and ongoing/revocable permissions.
Work Order System: Full lifecycle management from request through quoting, approval, work performed with photos and parts tracking, to completion.
Quote System: Structured mechanic quotes with labor, parts, rates, and revision workflow.
Parts Tracking & Database: Shared parts catalog with autocomplete, detailed per-work-order parts recording, and photo documentation.
Dual Rating System: Bidirectional ratings post-work order completion—owners rate mechanics; mechanics rate owners—supporting accountability and trust.
Mechanic Directory: Searchable and filterable directory with detailed mechanic profiles, availability status, and featured rankings.
Messaging: Real-time, direct messaging between owners and mechanics contextualized by vessels and work orders.
Notifications: In-app alerts for access requests, work orders, messages, ratings, onboarding reminders, and admin announcements.
Announcements System: Admin broadcast of role-targeted announcements with pinning and expiration functionality.
Help Center & Guides: Role-filtered, markdown-based in-app documentation and help content.
Admin Control Panel: Management tools for users, announcements, help content, and app settings.
Role-Adaptive Landing Page: Customized home screen dashboards with relevant stats, quick actions, feeds, and navigation per user role.
Theme System: Dark/light mode support with visually consistent glass morphism design.
user_flow_summary: Owner registers and onboards → adds vessel details and photos → unique QR code generated → printed/displayed on vessel for scanning.
Mechanic completes profile → scans vessel QR code → requests access → owner approves → mechanic accesses vessel info → creates and manages work orders.
Owner submits work order request → mechanic submits quote → owner reviews and accepts → work proceeds with documentation → completion and mutual rating.
Mechanic updates work order status with photos and parts → completes job → rates owner.
Owners maintain preferred mechanics list → communicate via messaging → receive notifications and service reminders.
Admins manage announcements, help guides, users, and overall system settings via control panel.
validation_criteria: Users can register and authenticate with proper role-based access control enforced.
Owners can add vessels with required details and generate unique QR codes linked correctly.
Equipment manifest supports all 15 categories with accurate service interval and condition tracking.
Mechanics can scan QR codes and trigger access request workflows that notify owners.
Access authorization system correctly permits and revokes mechanic access to vessel data.
Work order lifecycles flow through all states with proper data captured, including parts and photo documentation.
Quote submissions and revisions function correctly with notifications and owner acceptance.
Parts database autocomplete provides relevant suggestions; parts are logged per work order with full metadata.
Rating system stores and displays mechanics' and owners' ratings post-job completion with aggregated profiles.
Mechanic directory filters and sorts mechanics by availability, certification, rating, and location correctly.
Messaging delivers real-time communication contextualized by vessels and work orders with notification alerts.
Notifications appear in-app with accurate event types and mark-as-read functionality.
Admin systems allow full CRUD operations on announcements, help content, users, and settings with role checks.
Landing pages render role-specific content and statistics dynamically on login.
Dark mode toggle and theme preferences apply consistently across all UI components.

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Sign-in and sign-up flow using Convex Auth with email/password. Shows sign-in form for unauthenticated users and redirects authenticated users to dashboard or home.

features.name: Landing Page
features.description: Marketing-style landing page shown to authenticated users at /home with feature showcase and call-to-action sections.

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: Main role-based dashboard for authenticated users showing different views for owners, mechanics, and admins.

features.name: Vessel Management
features.description: Add, view, and manage vessels with QR codes. Each vessel gets a unique QR code for maintenance tracking.

features.name: Equipment Manifest
features.description: Comprehensive equipment tracking with 15 categories including service intervals, warranty, and condition monitoring.

features.name: Work Orders
features.description: Full work order lifecycle management including quote requests, quoting, approval, in-progress tracking, and completion.

features.name: Work Order Parts System
features.description: Parts tracking for work orders with autocomplete from a shared parts database.

features.name: QR Scanner
features.description: Browser-based QR code scanner for vessel identification using html5-qrcode.

features.name: Mechanic Directory
features.description: Searchable directory of marine mechanics with filters for certifications, availability, and ratings.

features.name: Mechanic Profile & Onboarding
features.description: Mechanic profile management and onboarding wizard with business details, certifications, and availability status.

features.name: Owner Profile & Onboarding
features.description: Owner profile management and onboarding flow for boat owners.

features.name: Dual Rating System

features.name: Preferred Mechanics

features.name: Access Control & Requests

features.name: Notifications
